articles.headline: Govt reduces petrol price by Rs2.27 per litre, high-speed diesel rate by Rs3.56
articles.summary: AI summary: Petrol and high-speed diesel prices were cut by Rs2.27 and Rs3.56 per litre respectively, effective September 29, bringing them to about Rs389 and Rs405 per litre while heavy per-litre taxes stay unchanged. Prices remain well above pre-crisis levels after spiking following the US-Iran conflict earlier this year, and fuel is now repriced daily in line with global markets.

articles.headline: CM Murad approves request to extend Mir Raza judicial commission's tenure
